The second isnad repeats every name, so there is no shared tail; each repeated name carries its occurrence number
«وروى» opens a chain with no «حدثنا»; the saying is Ibn Umar's own words («قوله»).
The second chain («حدثنا بذلك أبو كريب ...») carries the same words («نحوه») with its own names: a second route, not a variant.
Occurrence numbers separate the names the two chains repeat.
